text: dsh-plugin-wallpaper 是面向 DSH 网页端的壁纸切换插件，在侧边栏底部提供壁纸选择器和快速切换按钮。用户可从七种内置渐变中选择，也可添加本地图片作为背景；选择器支持移除已添加图片、调节图片遮罩浓度和恢复默认壁纸。插件通过 theme 服务覆盖背景与侧栏相关令牌，并针对浅色和深色模式提供配色。适合希望自定义 DSH 网页界面外观的用户。代码未显示 API 密钥或外部服务配置需求。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper adds wallpaper controls to the DSH web sidebar. Choose from seven gradients or add local images, adjust dimming, remove images, restore defaults, or cycle wallpapers. It applies theme tokens for light and dark modes. No API key or external service setup is shown.
想给 DSH 网页界面换个背景壁纸。
能不能上传自己的图片当作 DSH 背景？
I want to change the wallpaper in the DSH web interface.
dsh-plugin-wallpaper 的功能「选择和切换壁纸」：在侧栏打开选择器，从七种渐变或已添加图片中选择；也可点侧栏切换按钮循环到下一张。
dsh-plugin-wallpaper 的功能「添加本地图片并调节遮罩」：选择器读取用户挑选的图片并显示为壁纸，可删除图片；滑块按 5% 步进调整遮罩，或恢复默认背景。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · dsh-plugin-wallpaper：Wallpaper switcher for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) — a sidebar picker with local image upload, a dim slider, and a one-click next-wallpaper button.

壁纸切换插件（DeepSeek Harness）：在页面上直接添加本地图片壁纸、遮罩浓度滑块、一键切换下一张。 Inspired by [zcode-toolbar-wallpaper](https://github.com/Oct1AtJoe/zcode-toolbar-wallpaper).

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wallpaper
```

Refresh the page (or restart `dsh web`). Two buttons appear at the sidebar foot, next to Settings:

- **🖼 Wallpaper** — opens the picker: 7 built-in gradients, your uploaded images (hover a card to delete), a dim slider (0–100%, step 5, live preview), and *Restore default*.
- **⇄ Switch** — cycles to the next wallpaper without opening the panel.

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Features：- **Local images** — pick one or more files (jpg/png/webp/gif); large images are downscaled to 2560px in-browser (JPEG 85%, alpha kept for png/webp, GIF untouched) so the UI never stutters.
- **Dim slider** — a light-mode white / dark-mode black overlay keeps text readable at any wallpaper; default 60%.
- **Token-layer application** — wallpapers apply through the theme service's token-override layers (`--dsw-alias-bg-base`, sidebar fill, raised surface); disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores everything automatically.
- **Light/dark aware** — every built-in gradient ships a tuned pair for both color schemes.

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Notes：- Uploaded images live in the page's memory for the session; they are never written to disk or uploaded anywhere.
- This plugin only touches theme tokens via the public `theme.overrideTokens` API — no DOM hacks.
